text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":10,"why":"Patient described feeling tired and run down for the last 6 weeks."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":10,"why":"Patient described feeling tired and run down for the last 6 weeks."},{"i":2,"v":"INFERRED","u":35,"why":"Patient mentioned a rash on the back of his calf that appeared around the end of February, which is consistent with the claim."},{"i":3,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient did not mention having a fever or sore throat at the time of the rash."},{"i":4,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":24,"why":"Patient stated he doesn't think there has been any weight change."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":26,"why":"Patient mentioned eating smaller portions and having to make more of an effort to eat."},{"i":6,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient denied any visual or neurological symptoms."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":21,"why":"Patient denied any cough, sputum, chest pain, or shortness of breath."},{"i":8,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient denied any coryzal symptoms or sore throat."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":74,"why":"Patient denied any swelling in his hands, wrists, ankles, or toes."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":72,"why":"Patient mentioned aching shoulders, back, hips, and knees but denied any swelling."},{"i":11,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":79,"why":"Patient mentioned having asthma and hay fever in the past."}]}
